summary: Implemented motion enhancements for the Orang Minyak walk cycle, integrating grounded torso lean, weight-derived stance and swing lift arcs via smooth-squared sine envelopes, asymmetric arm overlap, and proper periodic loop phase calculations.
expectedEffect: The ghost silhouette displays more natural weight distribution with distinct support-side lowering, organic head tracking, smooth foot lift without velocity snaps, and correct periodic loop synchronization.
